application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding graded-Lie-array round was authoritatively rechecked and its 1344-source manifest was copied before new proof edits. Retained proof sources and exact selected axiom sets remain fixed.

The ambient scalar-extension lower-central bound is proved by genuine tensor and span inductions. The coefficient layer uses the actual original Lie lower central series and arbitrary scalar polynomials. A pure bracket multiplies those polynomials and lies in the original next layer. No bracket-closure or nilpotence premise about the array algebra is supplied.

The array Lie subalgebra cutoff uses the actual injective inclusion and the genuine Lie ideal map lower-central bound. The native specialization uses the retained native group-to-Lie theorem at the original group nilpotency class. No claim about a group containing input-shift automorphisms or equality of group and Lie lower-central layers is inferred.

Basis-coordinate extraction uses the actual tensor-product basis equivalence. Evaluation is proved compatible on pure tensors and extended by tensor induction. Integer casts form an infinite set in characteristic-zero fields. Polynomial extensionality on that infinite box yields coefficient vanishing; choice assembles an integer input vector from each point of the box. There is no unproved interpolation or separation assumption.

The proof works also for an empty input-variable type and for a zero original Lie algebra. Whole integer evaluation separation does not require finite dimension or a finite variable type. These finiteness hypotheses are used only for choosing a finite evaluation set from the genuine finite-dimensional array coefficient algebra.

Finite selection is proved using Artinian minimality of the actual range of finite kernel intersections. Adding one evaluation makes an intersection smaller; minimality forces reverse inclusion. The selected intersection therefore lies in every evaluation kernel, and the previously proved full separation makes it zero. The selected finite set is fixed before choosing any two coefficient arrays.

The finite evaluation map is a literal linear map into a finite product of original Lie-algebra values, and exact bracket preservation is stated component by component. This does not pretend that a native manifold or a Lie group has already been constructed on that image. The group construction, topology, lattice discreteness and cocompactness still require proofs.

Six new modules contain 15 theorems and two definitions, all 17 declarations selected for kernel audit. No proof holes, new axioms, structures, global instances, unsafe code or resource settings are introduced. Strict focused checks, full build, kernel checks, retained-source and exact-axiom comparisons and final recheck must terminate successfully.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. Construction and identification of its native simply connected array group, array-group topology, discrete cocompact lattice and smooth quotient evaluation remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the actual native polynomial-array model action with its required nilpotence and translation compatibility, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
